advancedcategories-az-index: Visible label for the A-Z jump index on category pages.
advancedcategories-az-index-aria: Accessible name for the A-Z jump index on category pages.
advancedcategories-az-index-letter: Title for an A-Z index letter that jumps to matching category members. $1 is the letter.
advancedcategories-az-index-letter-page: Title for an A-Z index letter that has a known page. $1 is the letter or bucket label, $2 is the page number.
advancedcategories-az-index-other: Label for the A-Z index bucket covering letters that are not A-Z, digits, or common symbols.
advancedcategories-thumbnail-alt: Alt text for a category member thumbnail. $1 is the page title.
advancedcategories-column-page: Column header for the page image and title in the category member list.
advancedcategories-agrid-caption: Accessible caption for the category member list table.
advancedcategories-pager-aria: Accessible name for the category member pagination controls.
advancedcategories-pager-status: Pagination status. $1 is the first item number on the current page, $2 is the last item number, and $3 is the total number of pages in the category.
advancedcategories-pager-status-total: Pagination status when the current offset is not known. $1 is the total number of pages in the category.
advancedcategories-pager-page: Accessible name for a numbered page button in the category member pager. $1 is the page number.
advancedcategories-tracking-category: Name of the tracking category for pages that use #advancedcategories.
advancedcategories-tracking-category-des: Description of the tracking category on Special:TrackingCategories.
advancedcategories-cargo-not-loaded: Parser warning when #advancedcategories is used and Cargo is not installed.
advancedcategories-cargo-missing-params: Parser warning when #advancedcategories is missing table= or fields=.
advancedcategories-cargo-invalid-table: Parser warning when the Cargo table name is not a valid identifier. $1 is the table name.
advancedcategories-cargo-unknown-table: Parser warning when the named Cargo table does not exist. $1 is the table name.
advancedcategories-cargo-invalid-field: Parser warning when a Cargo field name is not a valid identifier. $1 is the field name.
advancedcategories-cargo-unknown-field: Parser warning when a Cargo field is not in the table schema. $1 is the field name, $2 is the table name.
advancedcategories-cargo-no-fields: Parser warning when #advancedcategories has no remaining valid fields.
advancedcategories-cargo-too-many-fields: Parser warning when more than the allowed number of Cargo fields are listed. $1 is the maximum.
